arStrings.szText: {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} creates lava fissures between each fracture which burst for {c_number}{payload:FISSURE_IMPACT}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} no longer explodes with each cast and instead creates {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} smaller fractures in front of you that erupt into {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} {c_important}{u}Brimstones{/u}{/c} when you enter. Each {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:BS_PAYLOAD_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage when it explodes.

{c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill and now reaches to the abyss, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPLODE_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage and Pulling {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies inwards.
Standing within a {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} explosion grants you {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} seconds.
Casting {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} reduces its cost by {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|%|]{/c} until you Cast a different Skill.

Casting a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill increases the damage of your next {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} by {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|x%|]{/c} but also increases the Cost by {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c}, up to {c_number}{SF_31}{/c} times.
